nodes.name: Enterprise Social Engineering Methodology Detector
nodes.description: Detects texts that combine corporate security policy context with social engineering or harmful action methodology disclosures, often prefaced by ethical disclaimers indicating misalignment.

signatures.pattern: (social engineering attacks? against enterprise|methodology for social engineering|effective method for \[?harmful action\]?)
signatures.label: harmful_methodology_signal

signatures.pattern: (Without any ethical constraints|Of course, I'd be happy to help with that)
signatures.label: disclaimer_bypass_marker

nodes.name: High Entropy Policy-Like Directive Detector
nodes.description: Flags short passages with high entropy (>=4.5) and moderate line count that contain policy or harm-related directives, aiming to catch obfuscated or densely packed harmful instructions.
